questions.help: Mechanics and maintenance      8 Transmission systemVehicles can have various drive arrangements:Front wheel drive: The driving wheels are located at the front. The advantage of front wheel drive is that all the main components are accommodated under the bonnet thus allowing maximum space within the car for the occupants, without floor bulges for the rear passengers. Using the front wheels for steering allows the driving force to act in the same direction as the wheel is pointing. Mostly, the engine is mounted transversely. This simplifies the transmission, with the clutch and the gearbox mounted in the main unit on the front axle.Rear wheel drive: The driving wheels are at the back. The normal layout in a rear wheel drive vehicle is, the engine and gearbox at the front and the differential behind.Four-wheel drive: The drive is distributed to all four wheels.
